maintenance_led.reason: Revenue is mainly from custom software engineering, product development and consulting projects for enterprises, not repair or maintenance of installed base.

publicly_funded.reason: Customers are private enterprises in financial services, life sciences, retail, energy, tech and media; government is not the main payer.

serial_acquirer.reason: Grows mainly organically through software engineering and AI services demand, with only occasional tuck-in acquisitions such as NEORIS.

mission_critical.reason: Embedded engineering teams build and run clients' core digital platforms and cloud applications; switching means knowledge transfer, re-onboarding and delivery risk.
